newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Wheat output in key Brazil state to fall in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Wheat output in key Brazil state to fall in 1997.

text.p: Wheat production in the key Brazilian state of Parana should be 1.69 million tonnes, down from a harvest of 1.98 million tonnes last year, according to the latest estimate from the State Agricultural Secretariat.
In mid-May, the secretariat had estimated the harvest would reach between 1.75 million and 1.92 million tonnes.
Planted area is expected to fall 14 percent from 1996 due to low market prices, the secretariat said in a statement.
Independent consultants Safras e Mercado recently estimated output in the state, Brazil's largest wheat producer, at 1.59 million tonnes, down from 1.95 million tonnes in 1996.
Total Brazilian production is seen at 2.53 million tonnes, down 20 percent from 3.17 million tonnes in 1996, Safras said.
